subject.title: [Feature]: Built-in auto-update with configurable schedule, confirmation, and post-update notification

question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class core updater workflow with schedule/timezone, confirm or notify-only modes, channel targeting, and post-restart reporting, and what security defaults should gate silent updates?
rationale: The remaining work is not a narrow bug fix: it changes update config, unattended package replacement, operator consent, channel notification routing, and persisted restart state, so automation should not choose the product and security contract alone.

options.title: Sponsor a core updater workflow
options.body: Keep this issue open and design the opt-in core workflow around the supervised `update.run` or external-updater path, with explicit approval and notification boundaries.

options.title: Narrow to discoverability only
options.body: Treat the current package updater as enough for now and move only UI/onboarding guidance to a separate surface, leaving schedule and channel workflow out of scope.

options.title: Defer silent scheduling
options.body: Allow notify-only or confirm flows first and require a later maintainer decision before any silent unattended update mode ships.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a core updater workflow
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and design the opt-in core workflow around the supervised `update.run` or external-updater path, with explicit approval and notification boundaries.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the current auto-updater, authored the prior maintainer-facing review context, and is most directly tied to the remaining workflow boundary.
